title: BlackboardWorkerReceipt.v1
description: Mandatory PROVENANCE of one worker's turn on the blackboard: which worker (and kind) ran, which entries it wrote, the input/output content hashes (so the entries are tamper-evident and de-duplicable), an optional reference to the LLM-route receipt that backs any model call, and start/complete timestamps. The receipt records WHAT WAS DONE; it never asserts the written entries are true. No raw secrets/keys — hashes, an env:// or receipt-id reference, and ids only. llm_route_receipt_ref must be an env://<NAME> handle or a receipt id — NEVER a raw API key value.

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this turn operated on

worker_id.description: id of the bounded worker that ran

worker_kind.description: the worker's kind/role (e.g. observer, calculator, synthesizer); recorded for audit and convergence accounting

entries_written.description: entry_ids this worker wrote during the turn (lineage from receipt to entries)

input_hash.description: canonical hash of the turn input (tamper-evident; not the raw input)

output_hash.description: canonical hash of the written entries (tamper-evident; not the raw output)

llm_route_receipt_ref.description: OPTIONAL reference to the LLM-route/ModelInvocationReceipt backing any model call — an env://<NAME> handle or a receipt id; NEVER a raw API key value
